# ISSUE_TEMPLATE

GitHub issue form templates. All changes should arrive through issues (see [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../../CONTRIBUTING.md)).

| Template | Use for |
|----------|---------|
| [`feature.yml`](feature.yml) | New gameplay or infrastructure features (description, acceptance criteria, notes) |
| [`bug.yml`](bug.yml) | Defects (description, expected vs actual behavior) |
| [`config.yml`](config.yml) | Template chooser configuration |

Label an open feature issue `ready_to_plan` to start the agent planning workflow.
